title: Enigma of the Death Date
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's voice dropped to an extreme whisper, her eyes flashing a never-before-seen wariness—Destiny Arbiter, descending in thirty days. Chen Ji must complete his layout within this countdown, or what awaits him will be the complete erasure of his heavenly fate.

text.content: That gaze pressed down on his brow center like a physical weight, Chen Ji felt every hair on his body stand on end. The sealed characters deep within the Tianji Record were pulsing frantically, golden light piercing through his Mental Sea, dragging his consciousness into a chaotic Void. Countless images exploded before his eyes like shattered mirrors—ancient altars, blood-colored contracts, and a pair of indifferent eyes that pierced through countless ages.

"It has arrived." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's sigh echoed in the Mental Sea. "The backlash mechanism of the Tianji Record has been activated. By forcibly deducing the future three hours' fate trajectory before the imperial envoys, you've disturbed some taboos that should not have been touched." Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his chest, his Heavenly Fate Value draining away at a near self-destructive speed.

dialogue.content: "Tracing the origin of the certain-death calamity..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned grave, "Are you certain you want to do this? Once certain truths are glimpsed, you can never again pretend ignorance."

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, his consciousness already sinking into the sealed memory region deep within the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng had said that each volume of the target could unseal a page of knowledge. Now he needed answers—where did the certain-death calamity originate, and why did it fit so perfectly with the curse in his bloodline?

The scenery of the sealed region left him breathless. A majestic altar stood in the Void, covered with dense contract runes. Dozens of figures knelt prostrate on the ground, their faces indistinct, but each had a crack at their brow center identical to Chen Ji's—that was the Heavenly Fate Mark.

dialogue.content: "The Ancient Executor's Contract..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice trembling slightly from shock, "So the Tianji Record isn't a gift, but a kind of... transfer." He saw the Heavenly Fate Marks on those figures' brow centers being extracted, injected into a massive eye at the altar's center—the Eye of Heavenly Way.

text.content: The scene abruptly shifted. Chen Ji saw a familiar figure—Chen Tianming, or rather, his father in his youth. He stood precisely at the Eye of Heavenly Way's center, surrounded by countless contract chains, his eyes holding no fear, only a near-mad determination.

dialogue.content: "I use my heavenly fate to buy my son a sliver of survival." Chen Tianming's voice pierced through the ages, "But the contract is sealed, the death date is set. He must find a way to break it within thirty years, otherwise..." The voice cut off abruptly, the scene forcibly severed by a mysterious force.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat already soaking his back. The thirty-year deadline, the truth of his father's willing imprisonment at the Eye of Heavenly Way's core, and that existence watching everything from the shadows—all the fragments were assembling into a complete picture that made his spine chill.

dialogue.content: "It seems you've seen something interesting." Ye Qing's voice suddenly sounded from behind, she had somehow already stood three feet behind Chen Ji, demonic path mist floating gently around her, "The backlash fluctuation of the Tianji Record spread throughout the entire Tianqing Sect, I had to come early." Her eyes flickered with something complex, "Your complexion is terrible, Chen Ji."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's sudden appearance at such a coincidental timing. Was she monitoring him all along, or does she have ulterior motives? Chen Ji must judge this Holy Sect demonic saintess's true stance.

choices.description: Ye Qing and the Holy Sect's hatred is real; under the current situation, she is the only trustworthy external ally. Disclose the entire truth about the certain-death calamity to exchange for all her intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's own weaknesses, may be exploited
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Ye Qing's complete intelligence support, including key information about the Destiny Arbiter
choices.risk_hint: High risk, high reward; once her stance changes, it will be total loss

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, finally choosing to trust his own judgment. He娓娓道来 everything he had seen in the Tianji Record—the Ancient Executor's Contract, Chen Tianming's self-sacrifice, and the approaching thirty-day death date. Ye Qing's expression shifted from initial surprise to gravity, finally settling on a seriousness Chen Ji had never seen before.

dialogue.content: "Destiny Arbiter..." Ye Qing's voice dropped extremely low, as if the name itself carried some forbidden curse, "The ancient texts of the Holy Sect contain only fragments of records about them. They are executors of the Eye of Heavenly Way, specifically responsible for clearing those who attempt to break the rules of destiny... rebels."

choices.memory_label: 向夜清坦白必死劫真相

choices.description: Do not proactively expose one's cards, only reveal partial information, guide Ye Qing to speak her intelligence first, observe her reaction before making judgments.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, avoid exposing weaknesses, preserve room for later manipulation
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may therefore retain some key information

text.content: Chen Ji restrained his expression, concealing the most crucial details, only saying that when the Tianji Record was tracing the cause of the certain-death calamity, it triggered some prohibition, attracting the attention of imperial forces. Ye Qing listened quietly, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of her lips.

dialogue.content: "You're still testing me." Ye Qing laughed lightly, but without anger, "Very well, that's your instinct. But Chen Ji, there is something I must warn you about—the imperial court this time sent not only envoys, but also an... executor."

choices.description: Deliberately leak incorrect information, observe how Ye Qing uses this information to deduce her true stance and underlying forces. This is a higher-level psychological game.
choices.visible_cost: May cause Ye Qing to misunderstand
choices.visible_reward: Through false intelligence, lure the other party to expose their true intentions, possibly discover hidden third-party forces
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, will severely damage the relationship between both parties

text.content: Chen Ji smiled nonchalantly, beginning to tell a carefully woven half-truth story—the certain-death calamity originated from a Tianji Record loss of control, the imperial envoys came to retrieve the fragment. The moment his words ended, he noticed a subtle change flashing in Ye Qing's eyes—was that contempt for seeing through lies, or something deeper?

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ye Qing's smile became meaningful, "Chen Ji, your lies are more convincing than your truths. It seems you've already learned of the Destiny Arbiter's existence." She paused, "But you miscalculated one thing—I came to find you precisely because the arbiter has already set out."

text.content: Ye Qing took out a pitch-black Jade Slip from her sleeve, its surface flowing with eerie dark red patterns, as if some sealed curse was writhing within. "This is intelligence about the Destiny Arbiter I stole from Holy Sect texts using demonic path secret techniques—fragments only." She handed the Jade Slip toward Chen Ji, "After reading this, you'll understand why I say time is running out."

dialogue.content: "The Destiny Arbiter is not human; they are the executor consciousness projected by the Eye of Heavenly Way into the mortal realm. They have no fixed form, yet can mobilize the power of heavenly way laws to... characterize the target." Ye Qing's voice turned ice-cold, "Once characterized as a 'destiny rebel,' then no matter where you hide, you cannot escape the fate of being erased."

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, his divine sense probing within. In an instant, endless information flooded his mind like a tide—the Destiny Arbiter, each one was an inheritor or terminator of the previous generation's Tianji Record holder. After completing their mission, their consciousness would be reclaimed by the Eye of Heavenly Way, becoming new execution tools, never dying, yet forever losing themselves.

dialogue.content: "And the arbiter descending this time..." Ye Qing's gaze fell complexly on Chen Ji, "According to my intelligence, should be the person who competed with your father for the Tianji Record's inheritance thirty years ago—Ling Yuan's master." Her voice carried an almost imperceptible tremor, "He has been completely assimilated by the Eye of Heavenly Way; he is no longer human."

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his pupils contracting violently. Ling Yuan's master—that old monster who was said to have perished long ago, actually existed in this manner. More critically, he had been a generation competitor with his father, yet now must harvest Chen Ji's heavenly fate as an arbiter. Was this heaven's arrangement, or some deeper conspiracy?

"Thirty days." Ye Qing raised three fingers, "This is the time limit for the arbiter to travel from the imperial court to the Tianqing Sect. Once he descends, you will have no breathing room at all." She stepped forward, demonic path mist forming a barrier between them, "So Chen Ji, within thirty days you must find a method to break the certain-death calamity—or find leverage against the Eye of Heavenly Way."

dialogue.content: "Leverage?" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, "What do you mean?" Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, seemingly weighing her words: "Within the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds lies an ancient ruin, said to seal the core data left behind by the first Tianji Record holders. If you can obtain the information within, perhaps you can find a way to sever the connection between the Eye of Heavenly Way and your heavenly fate."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing threw out an enticing proposal—the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds ancient ruin. But that is a demonic path holy land, fraught with dangers, and Ye Qing's true purpose remains unclear. Chen Ji must weigh the pros and cons and make a choice.

choices.description: Although the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds is a dragon's den and tiger's lair, Chen Ji has no other choice. The thirty-day deadline is imminent; he must take the risk.
choices.visible_cost: Entering the demonic path holy land, exposing secret connections with the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information to sever the heavenly fate connection
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, will completely offend the three major sects

text.content: After careful deliberation, Chen Ji finally nodded. Thirty days, only thirty days. Missing this opportunity would await him a fate more terrible than death—the Destiny Arbiter. A barely perceptible relief flickered in Ye Qing's eyes, then quickly restored her usual coldness.

dialogue.content: "Excellent." Ye Qing turned, demonic path mist beginning to spread in all directions, "In three days, I will send someone to collect you. Remember, during this time do not make any large movements, to avoid打草惊蛇." Her voice suddenly dropped, "There is one more thing—your sister Chen Nian, she is still alive, and she is in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds."

choices.description: Ye Qing's words have too many suspicious points; demand she show more sincerity first—such as specific intelligence about the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, or proof she truly stands on his side.
choices.visible_cost: May anger Ye Qing, lose this ally
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more key intelligence, verify Ye Qing's true stance
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may therefore walk away in anger

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately agree, but stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes: "Before going to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, I need to know more. Why are you helping me? What did the Holy Sect give you that made you willing to seek me out at the risk of betrayal?" Ye Qing's expression slightly stiffened, then revealed a bitter smile.

dialogue.content: "Because I too am being watched by the Eye of Heavenly Way." Ye Qing's voice suddenly dropped low, "The reason the Holy Sect chose me as the saintess is not because of my talent, but because my bloodline also carries the ancient executor's curse. We are蚂蚱 on the same rope, Chen Ji."

choices.memory_label: 发现夜清与自己的命运关联

choices.description: Chen Ji will not make a losing deal; demand Ye Qing prove her sincerity with concrete actions—such as helping him resolve threats within the Tianqing Sect first, or providing certain key intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May appear overly calculating, deter people
choices.visible_reward: Obtain practical help before entering the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, reduce risk
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may think him too scheming

text.content: "I can help you, but I must see your sincerity first." Chen Ji's voice was calm, yet carried undeniable determination, "Someone within the Tianqing Sect wants to use the imperial envoys to eliminate me. If you truly want cooperation, help me resolve this trouble first." Ye Qing narrowed her eyes, seemingly reassessing this "waste" before her.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." Ye Qing laughed lightly, "You are the first man to dare negotiate conditions with me. Very well, I agree. Within three days, the elder colluding with the imperial court within the Tianqing Sect will 'accidentally' die. Is that enough sincerity?"

text.content: After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone in the courtyard, the night wind brushing past, bringing a chill. His mind kept replaying the scenes he saw deep within the Tianji Record—his father's determined figure standing at the Eye of Heavenly Way's core, and those words "I use my heavenly fate to buy my son a sliver of survival." Thirty days, only thirty days. Within this limited time, he must weave a chess game capable of confronting the Eye of Heavenly Way.
